hypotheses.reasoning: Consumer partition 10 is jammed by msg-798041 (offset 269792), which fails JSON parsing on a NUL byte at position 1341 on every attempt. The consumer nacks and redelivers it with no max-retry or dead-letter limit (attempt 5 -> 24+), so the partition stops advancing and lag grows (996 msgs at 02:54, 8208 at 03:03). Consumer CPU is normal because it is stuck retrying one message, not overloaded. Order-service timeouts (#188, #241, #257, #286) and the gateway impact are downstream of orders not being confirmed. Earlier GC pause (#61) and card processor reset (#70) are minor and do not explain the stall.

The malformed payload (embedded NUL byte) may have been corrupted upstream at the producer. This is the origin of the bad record, but the logs here do not show the producer, so it is an alternative reading of the same lines.

verdict.recommendedAction: Immediately skip or dead-letter msg-798041 (partition 10, offset 269792) so the partition resumes, then replay it after fixing it. Add a max-retry limit with a dead-letter queue to order-consumer. Find the producer that wrote a NUL byte into the payload and fix its serialization or validation. Reconcile orders that order-service marked failed after confirmation timeouts (e.g. o-2460, o-2487, o-2496, o-2515).
